verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an evaluation and observability platform, but the evidence never documents a capability to act on many selected items at once, such as bulk edit, delete, tag, export or annotate. The closest items are adjacent features: experiments that run over datasets, decision-model metrics for large text volumes, and review queues for traces. None of these is a bulk-operations capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
